function.name: cmd_controller_execute
function.description: Executes a system-level command using os.system() on Windows operating systems. It can execute single or multiple commands chained with '&&'. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

command.description: The system command to be executed. To execute multiple commands, separate them with '&&'. For example, 'dir && echo done'.

unit.description: Specifies the unit of measure for the command if applicable. This is not utilized by os.system() directly but can be used for logging or analysis purposes.

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "is any vpn is installed". They want to check if any VPN is installed. We need to use the cmd_controller_execute tool to run a command that checks for installed VPNs. On Windows, we could query installed programs via registry or wmic product. But maybe simpler: list installed programs via wmic product get name. Then filter for known VPN names? Or just list all installed programs and let user see.

We can run a command like `wmic product get Name` which lists installed products. That might produce a long list. Alternatively, we can query registry keys under HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall. But wmic is easier.

Thus we will call cmd_controller_execute with command: `wmic product get Name`. Provide unit N/A.
